summary: Cognetti stated on January 22, 2026, that she "vehemently supports Israel's right to defend itself" and would ensure Congress provides military aid to Israel. Her campaign platform addresses government-ethics measures—stock-trading bans, term limits, lobbying restrictions—with no plank on the war in Gaza or US military support for Israel. DMFI PAC, a committee aligned with Democratic Majority for Israel, recorded $381.82 in independent spending in her support.
